findings.title: abundance-warning provenance
findings.claim: The quantity noun joins the ayah's warning pattern in which impressive abundance can distort evaluation.
findings.mechanism: The abundance carrier at kathratu meets the supplied foul-quality contrast and the impressing clause, so the echo pressure colors quantity as a possible source of misjudgment without changing its construct role.
findings.reader_payoff: Quantity is heard as a pressure on judgment, not as proof that the measured thing has worth.
findings.containment: The warning echo colors the focus-local quantity relation; it does not import the cited contexts as additional evidence or make abundance intrinsically bad.

epistemic.reason: The local construct is trusted, while the wider warning relation is supplied as secondary echo provenance.

findings.title: construct subject of impressing
findings.claim: Kathratu is the grammatical subject that causes the impressing, with the following genitive phrase specifying what is abundant.
findings.mechanism: The nominative maṣdar carries the abundance action, and its construct contact with al-khabithi makes the foul class the content of that abundance before the causative verb reaches the addressee.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the sentence blames the abundance of a class, rather than treating quantity as a free-floating quality.
findings.containment: This is the focus construct relation; it does not claim that the noun itself guarantees the addressee's reaction.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: quantity as false metric
findings.claim: The ayah makes amount a misleading measure rather than evidence of worth.
findings.mechanism: Kathratu supplies amount, while the opposed khabith and tayyib classes and the concessive impressing clause expose contact between quantity and judgment as the metric being challenged.
findings.reader_payoff: A large count can be impressive without becoming a measure of goodness.
findings.containment: The finding rejects quantity as a sufficient criterion in this comparison; it does not deny every legitimate use of counting.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: bookend and accumulation echo
findings.claim: The repeated khabith at the thesis and inside the abundance phrase makes the concession specifically about abundance of the foul.
findings.mechanism: The first and second khabith carriers meet through the repeated definite class, so the later quantity phrase returns the reader to the very pole whose non-equivalence was first asserted.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence does not warn against abundance in general; it keeps the object of abundance audibly present.
findings.containment: The bookend is a focus repetition with supplied echo provenance, not a claim that the wider accumulation contexts are part of this ayah.

epistemic.reason: The repeated form and supplied echo rows support the relation, while its wider resonance remains bounded.

findings.title: genitive repeat of the foul class
findings.claim: The second al-khabithi is genitive and repeats the definite foul class as the content of abundance.
findings.mechanism: The genitive case is governed by the construct head kathratu, so the repeated definite adjective completes the quantity phrase and changes its grammatical role without changing its class identity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears exactly what is numerous: the foul class itself.
findings.containment: The case shift is grammatical; it does not create a new foulness branch or erase the first occurrence.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: foulness inside the abundance phrase
findings.claim: The mass named by abundance is itself foul; quantity does not neutralize its negative quality.
findings.mechanism: The al-khabithi carrier brings the supplied foulness and dross-like valence into contact with kathratu, making the mass morally non-neutral before it reaches the impressing verb.
findings.reader_payoff: The problem is not merely that there is much of something, but that there is much of what remains foul in kind.
findings.containment: Dross is a bounded quality image, not a technical metalworking translation of the ayah.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: result particle turns knowledge into response
findings.claim: Fa turns the evaluation into an imperative consequence.
findings.mechanism: The result particle carries the preceding non-equivalence and concession into the following command, so the response is grammatically produced by the judgment rather than introduced as a fresh subject.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah moves from seeing the distinction to doing something because it has been seen.
findings.containment: The consequence link does not specify every practical act of obedience; it only fixes the command's relation to the preceding thesis.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: knowledge converted to response
findings.claim: The ayah converts correct evaluation into a required response.
findings.mechanism: The fa carrier meets the completed quality-and-quantity comparison, and their contact changes the sentence from a statement about values into an action-demanding sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: Discernment is not left as private agreement with the maxim.
findings.containment: The response relation is focus-local and does not rank one form of action above another.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: taqwā and success formula echoes
findings.claim: Ittaqū enters the supplied taqwa-to-success command pattern while remaining the local response to quantity-dazzlement.
findings.mechanism: The plural protective-command carrier meets the result particle and the final success formula, so the recurring pattern frames the present command without replacing its immediate trigger.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a command structure in which protection is connected to a hoped-for successful course.
findings.containment: Formula provenance is secondary coloration; the local command remains grounded by its own syntax and object.

epistemic.reason: The supplied formula echoes are trusted, but they do not enlarge the local focus into a surah-wide claim.

findings.title: plural command as action pivot
findings.claim: The plural imperative changes the sentence from the singular experience of impressing to a collective commanded response.
findings.mechanism: The fa-linked second-person plural form meets the earlier singular object suffix on aʿjabaka, shifting the grammatical audience from one affected addressee to a group addressed for action.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence turns private susceptibility into shared responsibility.
findings.containment: The number contrast describes discourse movement; it does not identify a historical group beyond the supplied wording.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: reflexive shielding response

findings.mechanism: The Form VIII protective carrier meets the resultative fa and the direct-object Allah, so guarding becomes an active placement of the self in protection rather than mere avoidance of a bad quantity.
findings.reader_payoff: The remedy is an enacted posture of protection, not just a corrected opinion.
findings.containment: The finding keeps the self-protection image and divine object together; it does not generalize the word to every material protection sense.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: pivot in taqwā formula

findings.mechanism: The divine-name carrier meets the preceding protective imperative and the delayed vocative, so the sentence passes from action to its governing referent before naming those addressed.
findings.reader_payoff: The command is heard as a relation, not as abstract self-management.
findings.containment: The formula echo supports the pivot coloration; the local direct-object syntax remains decisive.

epistemic.reason: The supplied formula rows preserve the pattern, while the focus case and attachment control the finding.

findings.title: proper divine name as direct object

findings.reader_payoff: The command is not left grammatically abstract or objectless.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: divine referent reorients the metric

findings.reader_payoff: Protection has a direction and an accountable referent.
findings.containment: The local proper-name reading is retained; etymological worship associations remain background and are not activated as a separate branch.

findings.title: commanded proclamation frame

findings.reader_payoff: The first word tells the reader how the sentence is being performed.
findings.containment: The frame establishes commanded speech, not the identity or biography of an unstated speaker.

findings.title: public declaration channel

findings.title: negation of equality thesis

findings.title: false equivalence rejected
findings.claim: The ayah rejects false equivalence before quantity can claim authority over quality.
findings.mechanism: The negation carrier meets the levelness predicate and the later abundance concession, so the sentence refuses the measuring equation before admitting its psychological pull.
findings.reader_payoff: The impressive count is answered at the level of equivalence, not merely criticized after the fact.
findings.containment: The rejection is the focus comparison's boundary; it does not rank every possible comparison outside this pair.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: non-equivalence formula parallels
findings.claim: Yastawi participates in the supplied non-equivalence comparison formula while retaining the local foul-versus-wholesome pair.
findings.mechanism: The equality carrier meets the negation and the two coordinated classes, so the formula provenance reinforces comparison without importing the other cited comparisons into the focus.

findings.containment: The formula echo is bounded provenance; the local classes determine what is being compared.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: Form VIII levelness denied
findings.claim: The Form VIII yastawi brings levelness and equalizing pressure that the negation refuses between foul and wholesome.
findings.mechanism: The levelness carrier meets the two opposed quality carriers under la, so the form makes the denied balance perceptible before the concession tests it.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence resists the visual temptation to place unlike values on one scale.
findings.containment: Broader setting-straight and unrelated root branches remain outside the local reading.

epistemic.reason: The candidate-specific support explicitly narrows the root range to the local equality pressure.

findings.title: khabīth/ṭayyib opposition network
findings.claim: Khabith and tayyib belong to the supplied recurring network of opposed quality classes.
findings.mechanism: The foul carrier meets the coordinated wholesome carrier and the later repeated foul occurrence, so the local contrast resonates with the supplied quality pattern while remaining an ayah-local opposition.
findings.reader_payoff: The pair is heard as a durable quality contrast, not as two arbitrary examples.
findings.containment: The network is supplied as resonance provenance; no other ayah is landed as context here.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: definite foul class as first pole
findings.claim: The definite al-khabith is a substantivized class noun and the first pole of the comparison.
findings.mechanism: The definite foul carrier meets the nominative comparison frame and the coordinated tayyib pole, so an adjective-like quality becomes a named class placed first.
findings.reader_payoff: The sentence compares kinds of value rather than unnamed individual objects.
findings.containment: The first position is structural and does not rank the class as more important than the second pole.

epistemic.reason: The trusted focus analysis directly establishes the bounded relation.

findings.title: dross-like foulness
findings.claim: Khabith carries intrinsic foulness and a dross-like refusal, not merely the narrower idea of legal prohibition.
findings.mechanism: The foul carrier meets tayyib as its explicit contrary and kathratu as the later mass, so negative quality remains inside the quantity phrase.
findings.reader_payoff: A thing can be numerous and still retain the character of refuse or baseness.
findings.containment: The dross image is a lexical coloration bounded by the supplied branch evidence; it is not a technical smelting scene.
